title: Open Camping DB distinct places
description: moderation/distinct_places.json. Pairs the duplicate finder flagged that a person checked and found to be separate places. The finder leaves these pairs out from then on.

a.description: The place id that sorts first.

added.description: Day the pair was checked, YYYY-MM-DD.

reason.description: pitches: separate pitches, access points or camp spots. sections: parts of one ground with different rules, such as a caravan area and a tent area. direction: one for each side of a road. gender: separate facilities for men and women. other: see note.

note.description: What the person saw, in a sentence.
